posts.author: Meghan Montemurro
posts.text: The Cubs beat the Reds, 5-2, to stay in the NL's first wild card spot while the Phillies drop behind them with their loss tonight. The Cubs' magic number to clinch a playoff spot: 2
posts.jp: カブスがレッズを5-2で下し、NLのワイルドカード1位をキープ。フィリーズは今夜の敗戦で後退。カブスのプレーオフ進出マジックナンバー：2

posts.author: Tim Stebbins
posts.text: José Ramírez Home run No. 297. 1,000 career RBIs 5-3 Cleveland
posts.jp: ホセ・ラミレスが通算297本目のホームラン。通算1000打点達成 クリーブランド5-3

posts.author: Keegan Matheson
posts.text: It’s 1:59am and the bartender is flicking the lights on and off. #BlueJays
posts.jp: 午前1時59分。バーテンダーが照明をチカチカ消してる。#BlueJays

posts.author: Keegan Matheson
posts.text: The simple version is that the #BlueJays are now three games back from a playoff spot with eight games left, whether they’re chasing the White Sox or the Guardians. Chicago goes 4-4? They need 7-1. Chicago goes 5-3? They need 8-0. Add in the Rangers? This is not good.

reply_texts.text:
It’s over. I’ve been an optimist through all of this, but tonight was awful. 

If the team can’t pick of the best starter we’ve had all year in a a bad night, then they’re not going far even  if they make the off-season. 

It looks like they have all checked out.
reply_texts.author: derek.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: It’s been a long shot for a while with so many teams in the mix. They gave us some brief hope but it’s most likely over now.
reply_texts.author: whitbywino.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: There was hope only because the AL is littered with sub-500 teams. But with a brittle staff of starting pitchers and an utterly dismal year from the $50 million dollar man, this team is exactly where they deserve to be.
reply_texts.author: trippsteve.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: Especially not good with the Sox playing the Royals and Rockies, mostly at home. They’d have to completely fall apart to not win 4-5 of those. Incredible tbat the pitching was so good, that just one fewer injury and they might’ve carried a bottom-3 offence to the playoffs.
reply_texts.author: buddytheelf.bsky.social

posts.jp: ブルージェイズは残り8試合で3ゲーム差。ホワイトソックス追いかけにしろガーディアンズ追いかけにしろ同じ。シカゴが4-4なら相手は7-1必要。シカゴが5-3なら8-0必要。レンジャーズも絡む？これはヤバい。

posts.author: Matt Gelb
posts.text: The Phillies are demoting Orion Kerkering to Triple A, sources said. More on the decision and current pitching outlook here: www.nytimes.com/athletic/761...
posts.jp: フィリーズがOrion KerkeringをトリプルAに降格指定、複数筋の報道。

posts.author: Andy Kostka
posts.text: A standing ovation for Trevor Rogers as he departs the mound after eight innings of one-run ball. This could be his final Camden Yards start as an Oriole. If it is, it was superb
posts.jp: Trevor Rogersが8回1失点の好投を終え、スタンディングオベーション。これがオリオールズでの最後のカムデン・ヤーズ登板になるかも。もしそうなら、素晴らしい投球だった

posts.author: Matt Gelb
posts.text: Ugly, ugly stuff for the Phillies in the sixth inning. Brooks Raley doesn't retire a man, Justin Crawford misplays a ball in CF, and Chase Shugart walks the No. 9 hitter to force home a run. Ugly.

reply_texts.text: This is not a playoff team
reply_texts.author: dianer.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: Can they leave Raley at Citi Field?
reply_texts.author: nsbulk.bsky.social

reply_texts.text:
Badly coached team performs badly

Got tomorrow's headline for ya!
reply_texts.author: fairmountjack.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: This is not a serious ball club
reply_texts.author: tsgodfrey.bsky.social

posts.jp: フィリーズの6回は散々な内容。Brooks Raleyがアウトが取れず、Justin Crawfordが中堅でエラー、Chase Shugartが9番打者に四球で失点。ひどい。

posts.author: Meghan Montemurro
posts.text: Who needs rehab games? Dansby Swanson, in his second game back, goes deep to LF for his 19th homer of the year, extending the Cubs' lead to 5-2 over the Reds in the 9th.
posts.jp: リハビリゲーム不要？Dansby Swansonは復帰2試合目で左中間へ本塁打。今季19本目でカブスのリードを9回に5-2に広げた
